## Work Session Report

Game log analysis (game_log_20260215_231653.txt):

Log showed that during player initialization, entries exist for all active items ([Player.Flashlight], [Player.TeleportBracers], [Player.Homing], [Player.InvisibilitySuit], [Player.BreakerBullets]) — but NO [Player.ForceField] entries at all.

Root cause: At the time of testing, _init_force_field() had not been implemented. Without initialization, _force_field_equipped = false (default), and _handle_force_field_input() returns immediately — pressing Space has no effect.

What was done in this session:
1. Downloaded and saved the game log to docs/case-studies/issue-676/
2. Conducted full root cause analysis (case study: docs/case-studies/issue-676/README.md)
3. Resolved merge conflict in active_item_manager.gd — added FORCE_FIELD to unlock system from main, kept has_force_field()
4. Cleaned ForceFieldEffect.tscn — removed duplicate nodes that conflicted with programmatically created ones (script creates them in _ready())
5. Updated mock class in test_armory_unlock.gd for FORCE_FIELD compatibility
6. Merged main, PR ready for review

Visual activation code (added in previous commits):
- _init_force_field() loads ForceFieldEffect.tscn and adds as child node
- _handle_force_field_input(delta) called in _physics_process — on Space hold calls activate(), on release calls deactivate()
- activate() sets _shield_sprite.visible = true (blue pulsing shield via shader)
